symptom: describe microflow printed `validation feedback $O/A message '{1} …';` with no template arguments; describe -> exec stored the feedback with none
cause: formatAction's ValidationFeedbackAction case never read TemplateParameters, although the reader (textTemplateFromGen) and the writer both carried them
insight: A text template has two halves, the text and its parameters; check every describe case that prints one prints both. Found while switching the template form to `with ({1} = …)` (ako/mxcli#751).
